title: Every day, all week, on Saturdays

blocks.text: каждый день (понедельник, вторник, четверг) — masc. (acc.); каждое утро (воскресенье) — neut. (acc.); каждую среду (пятницу, субботу) — fem. (acc.). весь день (год, месяц) — masc. (accus.); всё утро (лето) — neut.; все дни (годы) — plur.; всю неделю (зиму, осень, ночь) — fem.

The preposition по + dat. pl. is used to indicate that something occurs periodically: 1. on a certain day of the week: *По понедельникам я работаю в штабе. По воскресеньям мы отдыхаем.* 2. during a certain time of a day: *По утрам я читаю газету. По вечерам его никогда нет дома.* Note: never «по дням» except when a modifier is used: по целым дням — days on end; по выходным дням — on off-days.
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 22, 37, 74.

The exercises are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. The word in brackets is the dictionary form of the missing word.

exercises.q: Враг атаковал ___ (весь день).
exercises.prompt: The enemy kept up their attack all day.
exercises.why: «весь» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: По ___ (вечера), к семи часам, улицы этого города пустеют.
exercises.prompt: By seven o'clock in the evening, the streets are deserted in this town.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: У нас пять уроков англа в ___ (неделя).
exercises.prompt: We have five English classes a week.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Do you wash your dog every day?
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He is always a little irritable in the morning.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I went to bed at midnight.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я ___ (вся ночь) проворочалась с боку на бок.
exercises.prompt: I tossed and turned all night.
exercises.why: «весь» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Она всегда занята по ___ (будни).
exercises.why: «по» + dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Телестанции вещают 24 часа в ___ (сутки).
exercises.prompt: Television stations broadcast 24 hours a day.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I straighten my hair every morning.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom wets his bed.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: On Monday, she gave birth to her first child.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я подстригаюсь ___ (каждый месяц).
exercises.prompt: I get a haircut every month.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Она мудра не по ___ (годы).
exercises.prompt: She is wise beyond her years.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Спидометр сейчас показывает 100 миль в ___ (час).
exercises.prompt: The speedometer is recording 100 mph now.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It rained continuously all day.
exercises.why: «целый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The karaoke shop is especially crowded on Saturdays.
exercises.ru: В магазине караоке особенно многолюдно по ___.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom's income totals thirty thousand dollars a year.
exercises.ru: Общая сума доходов Тома составляет тридцать тысяч долларов в ___.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: ___ (каждая зима) у меня трескаются губы.
exercises.prompt: I get chapped lips every winter.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Она делает домашнее задание по ___ (пятницы), чтобы не пришлось заниматься этой нудятиной на выходных.
exercises.prompt: She does her homework on Fridays to save herself from the drudgery of having to do it during the weekend.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
